$comment: Ledger of gitleaks release artifacts whose bytes a human ACTUALLY downloaded and hashed.
Read scripts/check-gitleaks-pin.mjs first — this file is one half of a two-place tripwire.
It exists so that bumping GITLEAKS_VERSION in .github/workflows/ci.yml without re-vetting the
artifact reddens a named, actionable check instead of dying inside a CI step with an opaque
`sha256sum: FAILED`. Duplication is the POINT: the check compares ci.yml against this file, so a
single-sided edit cannot be silently self-consistent.
NEVER add or edit an entry by copying the value out of ci.yml — that turns the tripwire into a
rubber stamp. Obtain the digest from the bytes:
and record what it prints, together with the byte size and the date it was fetched.
What a matching entry proves: the pinned digest is the one someone vetted. What it does NOT
prove: that upstream was honest at publication. The pin is trust-on-first-use byte-freezing

8.24.3.note: Downloaded and hashed independently in this repo (not copied from mercata's constant); byte-identical to the sibling repo's pin.
